## Real kinetic fits and next observation contract (2026-10-23)

[Registered exact and sampled-hybrid biological report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1497d9b84fd26c94d5185cfdbf94c8b45a370009/experiments/2026-10-23_1202_codex_biological-cut-rates/README.md). The source/recipe stage is now implemented; #775 is closed and is not reopened by this follow-up. This broader issue still owns source-linked observation support. Prior body statements saying no biological fit exists are historical.

The shared 2.0.9 recipe (manifest5f616170b5514cb4d8f0c7b7843d232959e9514eebbca6483f976e17b0846615) supplies 30,566 curves and 93,734 declared temporal ratio targets. A 40-coefficient ordered sequence-to-cut-rate model and an actual 2,000-update sampled-partition hybrid both train. Exact validation/test log10-response RMSE is1.09556/1.02057; sampled1.07721/1.04386; one-rate control1.18114/1.01798. No sequence model beats all controls on both splits. All8,000 updates and562,404 predictions independently replay. Outputs vary, but no APC concentration or independent MS-response calibration is established.

The training-only process-shape diagnostic finds repeated trajectories inconsistent with this simple independent-cut/constant-response assumption: at >0.3log10 discrepancy,7.47% of weighted ratios exceed the boundary-cut growth envelope and9.59% of triplets violate log-concavity. The cause is unresolved; this is not a claim of incorrect source data.

Next shared recipe/query acceptance should expose the already curated raw/filtered/corrected/time-zero/noise contributors alongside each admitted curve, retaining units, charges/modifications, actual acquisition/biological labels, per-peptide reference time, background rule and selection/censor disposition. Preserve original eligibility/values/IDs and provide every excluded slot; do not invent physical technical-pair links or convert MS response to concentration. This enables a training-only observation diagnostic before changing kinetics. Reuse canonical relations rather than add a Presto curator. Broader known-load response calibration remains #762. No author outreach requested.

### Biological sequence-to-cut-rate results (2026-10-23)

[Full registered report and frozen evidence](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1497d9b84fd26c94d5185cfdbf94c8b45a370009/experiments/2026-10-23_1202_codex_biological-cut-rates/README.md). Adds a reusable independent-cut primitive and real sequence-conditioned biological exact/sampled-hybrid fitting on shared Hitlist2.0.9 digestion time courses. All8,000 optimizer updates,16 noninitial checkpoints and562,404 predictions independently replay. All allocated coefficients train;18 focused tests pass. Exact and sampled predictions are nonconstant, but neither model beats all controls on both validation and test, so no biological model is promoted. Exact sequence+protocol val/test RMSE1.09556/1.02057; sampled1.07721/1.04386; one-rate control1.18114/1.01798. The single-seed hybrid takes roughly16.6times exact fit time and retains exact residuals/probabilities. Original/canonical rank outputs, figures, failure logs and source hashes are preserved. Follow-up is source-linked observation diagnostics and restrictive-process checks; full APC concentrations, independent MS response, downstream machinery and prior IC50 qualification remain unresolved. This PR remains draft.
